items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Secures $17 Billion VA Contract Expansion For Health Records
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) secured a major expansion of its contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs for Oracle Health's electronic health record system, adding a potential US$17b in value. The expanded agreement extends the rollout timeline for the VA's electronic health record system, increasing Oracle's exposure to a large U.S. government healthcare client. items.title: OpenAI data center chief exits as 4 executives leave ahead of 2027 IPO
items.summary: Malone joined OpenAI in March 2025, shortly after the company unveiled Stargate — a joint venture with Oracle and SoftBank to build AI data-center capacity at scale. His exit follows the departures of Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser, Chief Operating Officer Brad Lightcap, and Fidji Simo, who served as second-in-command to CEO Sam Altman, according to the WSJ report.
